name: Sycamore Tussock Moth
desc: Sycamore Tussock Moth (Halysidota harrisii): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Halysidota harrisii, the sycamore tiger moth, is a moth belonging to the family Erebidae and the tribe Arctiini, the tiger moths. The species was first described by Benjamin Dann Walsh in 1864.
